Now we describe things by their color (لون — loon) and size. This builds directly on the article rule from the grammar chapter: an adjective follows its noun and matches it. Tap any sentence to reveal its franco and English.

## How it works

**Basic colors come in a pair** — a masculine *a‑* form and a feminine *‑a* form: **أحمر (a7mar)** / **حمرا (7amra)**. The "derived" colors that end in **‑i** (*bonni, ramadi…*) take **‑eyya** in the feminine (*bonneyya*), though in everyday speech they're often left unchanged.

**Sizes work the same way** — a masculine and a feminine form: *kebir / kebira*.

**Definiteness still applies** (from the grammar chapter): if the noun has ال, the color or size takes ال too — **الفستان الأحمر (el-fustan el-a7mar)** "the red dress". Drop the article from the adjective and you get a sentence: **الفستان أحمر (el-fustan a7mar)** "the dress **is** red".

**Stacking color + size:** put both after the noun, each with ال if the noun is definite — **الفستان الأحمر الطويل (el-fustan el-a7mar el-tawil)** "the long red dress".

## Colors

| Masculine - franco | Feminine - franco | English |
|---|---|---|
| أحمر - a7mar | حمرا - 7amra | red |
| أزرق - azra2 | زرقا - zar2a | blue |
| أخضر - a5dar | خضرا - 5adra | green |
| أصفر - asfar | صفرا - safra | yellow |
| أبيض - abyad | بيضا - beda | white |
| إسود - eswed | سودا - soda | black |
| بني - bonni | بنية - bonneyya | brown |
| رمادي - ramadi | رمادية - ramadeyya | grey |
| برتقاني - borto2ani | برتقانية - borto2aneyya | orange |
| وردي - wardi | وردية - wardeyya | pink |
| بنفسجي - banafsegi | بنفسجية - banafsegeyya | purple |

## Sizes

| Masculine - franco | Feminine - franco | English |
|---|---|---|
| كبير - kebir | كبيرة - kebira | big |
| صغير - soghayyar | صغيرة - soghayyara | small |
| طويل - tawil | طويلة - tawila | long / tall |
| قصير - 2osayyar | قصيرة - 2osayyara | short |
| واسع - wase3 | واسعة - was3a | loose / wide |
| ضيق - dayya2 | ضيقة - dayy2a | tight |

<summary>القميص الأبيض</summary>
<span class="fr">el-2amis el-abyad</span>

</details>

</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>العربية حمرا</summary>
<span class="fr">el-3arabeyya 7amra</span>
<span class="en">the car is red (feminine agreement)</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>الفستان الأحمر الطويل</summary>
<span class="fr">el-fustan el-a7mar el-tawil</span>
<span class="en">the long red dress</span>
</details>

<details class="frase">
<summary>البنطلون ده ضيق</summary>
<span class="fr">el-bantalon da dayya2</span>
<span class="en">these trousers are tight</span>
</details>

## Dialogue: at the shop

Reem is looking for clothes; Khaled is helping.

<span class="rotulo">ريم — Reem</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>عايزة بلوزة بيضا</summary>
<span class="fr">3ayza boloza beda</span>
<span class="en">I want a white blouse</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">خالد — Khaled</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>البلوزة دي بيضا وواسعة</summary>
<span class="fr">el-boloza di beda we was3a</span>
<span class="en">This blouse is white and loose</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">ريم — Reem</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>لأ، عايزة واحدة ضيقة</summary>
<span class="fr">la2, 3ayza wa7da dayy2a</span>
<span class="en">No, I want a tight one</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">خالد — Khaled</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>والقميص ده؟ أزرق وكبير</summary>
<span class="fr">wel-2amis da? azra2 we kbeer</span>
<span class="en">And this shirt? Blue and big</span>
</details>

<span class="rotulo">ريم — Reem</span>
<details class="frase">
<summary>تمام، بحب الأزرق</summary>
<span class="fr">tamam, ba7ebb el-azra2</span>
<span class="en">Great, I like blue</span>
</details>

Try each one out loud first, then tap **Show answer**.

### Exercise 1 — Make it agree

Give the right form for the noun's gender.

**1.** القلم (m.) + blue

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">القلم الأزرق</span>
<span class="fr">el-2alam el-azra2</span>
</details>

**2.** العربية (f.) + red

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">العربية الحمرا</span>
<span class="fr">el-3arabeyya el-7amra</span>
</details>

**3.** البنطلون (m.) + big

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">البنطلون الكبير</span>
<span class="fr">el-bantalon el-kebir</span>
</details>

**4.** البلوزة (f.) + small

<details class="ans">
<summary>Show answer</summary>
<span class="ar">البلوزة الصغيرة</span>
<span class="fr">el-boloza el-soghayyara</span>
</details>
